Welcome to Remon Milk

Remon Milk is a dairy company based in the Nakawa Industrial Area of Kampala. We make fresh milk, drinking yoghurt and premium cheese, all from the milk of our own pasture-raised cows.

Every product is made at our plant in Kampala, where our team looks after each batch from start to finish. We keep our process simple and our standards high, so what reaches you is fresh, tasty and made with care.

You may have already met us at a local event or tasting. Whether you want to place an order or stock our products in your shop, we would be glad to hear from you.

100%Made in Kampala
